name: SubQuery Settings missing setter authorization
summary: Settings.setContractAddress() and setBatchAddress() lacked owner checks, so five transactions installed attacker-controlled critical-role addresses and used the resulting StateChannel, staking, rewards, token, and booster authority to drain Treasury funds, pooled stake, deployment boosters, and 272 approved wallets.

loss.notes: Exact stolen SQT is the sum of attacker-controlled recipients' net increases across the five loss receipts: 7,123.035017761666600000; 218,070,478.035174175990999309; 11,819,839.568823074202091517; 22,811,586.289378905375499424; and 129,364,800.151362385762131451 SQT. It excludes 359,614.732487847483438659 SQT of withdrawal fees retained by the protocol Treasury, which explains the difference from SubQuery's rounded 382,433,441 SQT gross-withdrawal figure. The latest CoinGecko observation before the anchor values the stolen amount at $220,502.84.

ageReset.description: The Settings proxy's creation transaction emitted its only pre-anchor Upgraded event, selecting implementation 0xf282737992da4217bf5f8b6ae621181e84d7d3b9. Its EIP-1967 slot and the implementation's runtime hash remained unchanged through the pre-anchor block.

sources.note: Reviewed the five official loss transactions and parity traces, SubQuery's post-mortem, commit-pinned reproduction, Settings source and deployment, complete Upgraded history, historical implementation slot and runtime, exact SQT Transfer logs, and historical price data. Anchor 0x7b6d7850466a985cec6618c95046b9c08c77891d901a28e549a2741b05945a72 is the earliest loss transaction: its constructor calls unguarded setContractAddress(uint8,address) on Settings and drains 7123.035017761666600000 SQT from the Treasury. The later receipts transfer net 218070478.035174175990999309, 11819839.568823074202091517, 22811586.289378905375499424, and 129364800.151362385762131451 SQT to attacker-controlled recipients through the pooled-staking, booster, and 272-wallet paths. Their exact sum with TX5 is 382073827.079756302997321701 SQT; 359614.732487847483438659 SQT of standard withdrawal fees remained in the Treasury and are not loss. The anchor trace executes setContractAddress through the Settings proxy and implementation. Later traces exercise setBatchAddress or setContractAddress through the same artifact. The proxy's creation-block Upgraded event is its only one before the anchor; its EIP-1967 slot selects 0xf282737992da4217bf5f8b6ae621181e84d7d3b9 continuously from block 10512216 through block 44589595. That 1,966-byte implementation hashes to 0x3a798979d07a6c3d7d58480893a8564f021f616f5713295a03d8ce8cd126c391 at both endpoints. Code age is 68,154,760 seconds.
